message: Extreme wind gusts common Oct–Mar on the Grey glacier shore. Do not attempt crossing in winds exceeding 60 km/h. Check at refugio before departing.
Open fires strictly prohibited throughout the park. Stoves only. Violations result in permanent ban and criminal charges.
John Gardner Pass (1241m) can be icy and exposed year-round. Microspikes recommended. Pass closes in extreme weather — check with CONAF ranger.
